io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.net.Wifi

Packages that use Wifi
Package
Description
io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware
The board's own hardware and program-wide introspection: ArduinoUno and ArduinoNano hand out the board's pins, I2C bus, USB mouse, LED matrix, clock, BoardModel (which board the program was compiled for) and BoardMemory (Juno's arena and the program's flash usage).
io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.wifi
Wi-Fi shields, currently ArduinoWifiShield: the retired Arduino WiFi Shield, which gives the UNO R3 the Wifi it has no radio for.
io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.internal
The board's native implementations: the classes whose methods are compiler intrinsics.

    NativeWifi
    The board's Wifi: each method is a Wi-Fi intrinsic the compiler lowers to the board's networking library, so it has no Java body and cannot run, or be mocked, on a desktop JVM.
